answer: Spaced-recall credits cap grading. A reviewer spends one credit on an answer, then hours later must pick which claim it defended from four paraphrases; the credit returns only on correct recall. An orchard of cloned posts using whisper and opal can be stamped in seconds, but no one remembers their theses, so the farm burns its budget and later ballots stop counting. An honest reader recalls one argument read earlier at near-zero extra cost. Attacker cost: one true delayed memory per vote, or a separate human per identity, with no shared credit pool.
